'''Flayn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Dating" /> he was stationed on [[Quesh]] at the [[Planetary Sensor Station]] that detected enemy ships attempting to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and made them easy targets for Imperial fleet. During a holo-report to the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]], the station was assaulted by the [[Voidhound]] who shot Flayn down.<ref name="TOR" />
